title: Exact quantum circuits for a Heisenberg triangle with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
summary: We construct short analytical quantum circuits for the exact evolution of a spin triangle with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interaction. We consider pure DM interaction with arbitrary real couplings and two Hamiltonian families with uniform Heisenberg exchange. For pure DM, a change of basis reduces the evolution to two single-qubit rotations. The circuits reproduce the full evolution operator at arbitrary time with a fixed gate count and admit implementations with both triangular and linear qubit connectivity.
